# vcp_vmware_server (Data Source)

Fetch a single VMware Cloud server by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Fetch a single VMware server by ID.
data "vcp_vmware_server" "web" {
  id = 5678
}

# Whether the guest of that machine may run its own hypervisor.
output "web_nested_hypervisor" {
  value = data.vcp_vmware_server.web.nested_hypervisor
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Server ID. Give this or name.
- `name` (String) Display name of the server. Give this or id; the name must be unique.

### Read-Only

- `computer_name` (String)
- `cpu` (Number)
- `created` (String)
- `gpu` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gpu))
- `image_id` (Number)
- `is_power_on` (Boolean)
- `location_id` (Number)
- `nested_hypervisor` (Boolean) Whether the guest OS may run its own hypervisor (nested virtualization).
- `nics` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nics))
- `ram_mb` (Number)
- `state` (String)
- `system_disk_mb` (Number)
- `system_disk_type` (String)
- `vm_tools_installed` (Boolean)
